# Manna Bakery

> Manna Bakery is a handcrafted bakery, cafe, and gathering place at 306 Commerce St in Tomball, Texas. The bakery serves fresh breads, pastries, breakfast, lunch, and drinks, and offers catering and private event rentals.

## Official pages

- [Home](https://mannabread.com/): An introduction to Manna Bakery, its food, space, founder, and Tomball location.
- [Menu](https://mannabread.com/menu): Current status of Manna's online menu and a link to official Toast ordering.
- [Our Story](https://mannabread.com/our-story): Christin's story and the faith, family, and experiences behind Manna Bakery.
- [Catering](https://mannabread.com/catering): Catering selections, service details, and the catering inquiry form.
- [Gift Cards](https://mannabread.com/gift-cards): The official path to purchase a Manna Bakery gift card.
- [Private Rentals](https://mannabread.com/rentals): Spaces, capacity, policies, pricing, and the rental inquiry form.
- [Contact and Visit](https://mannabread.com/contact): Address, hours, phone, email, directions, and the general inquiry form.

## Verified business details

- Name: Manna Bakery
- Tagline: Bread from Heaven
- Address: 306 Commerce St, Tomball, TX 77375
- Phone: (832) 843-3999
- Email: support@mannabread.com
- Hours: Monday through Saturday, 6:00 AM–4:00 PM; closed Sunday
- Online ordering is fulfilled through Manna Bakery's official Toast page.
